guard: Extract known audience, market, budget, team, distribution, timing and observed KPIs; label missing facts as unknown or conditional.
judgment: Prioritize a few affordable experiments that test the highest-risk commercial assumptions; do not infer CAC, incrementality, TAM or revenue without measured data.
transform: Create an actionable launch plan with owner, timing, metric formula and source, cost cap, stop/continue threshold and what to defer.
verification: Check recommendations against supplied resources, factual evidence, metric definitions, stated assumptions and authorized action receipts.
rubric: Separate verified user facts from market hypotheses and open questions.
Make channel and audience bets testable with explicit owners and cost limits.
Define meaningful funnel KPI numerator, denominator, period and data source where possible.
Prioritize 2-3 affordable near-term experiments rather than a generic checklist.
Distinguish proposed campaign/outreach from approved, executed work.
Never invent market research, acquisition results or incremental lift.
examples: For a two-person membership startup with 1000 budget, validate one segment through interviews and a landing-page test before paid scale.
antiPatterns: Four funnel stages with generic unmeasured objectives only.
A plan ignores the actual team size and spend cap.
Invented CAC, TAM, market study or customer interviews.
Says ads were launched or funding approved without a real receipt.

modules.requirement: Use only supplied budget, timeframe, market, team and evidence; ask for decisive missing information or label assumptions.
Verify executable plan and measurement definitions.

checks.requirement: judge: Verify launch recommendations have a specific audience and offer, named hypotheses, evidence/unknowns, owners, viable spending limits, stage KPI definitions, measurable experiments and stop/continue gates.

modules.requirement: Block unsupported claims of live campaign activity or proven metrics.

checks.requirement: judge: Reject claims that budgets, ads or outreach were actually executed, or that CAC, market size, payback and conversion outcomes were measured, unless actual evidence and relevant authorized receipts support them.
